label: focused_benchmark
what_this_is: A controlled, non-production TRUE FIRST REGISTRATION replay: the AUDITED shared code taking a state in which Raleigh is absent in every way through the acquisition deliverable (captured inputs + the market's own helpers, installed from the frozen branch), the offline build steps, and the ORDINARY registration and readiness workflow, with Regression V2 in normal mode. Nothing was deployed, nothing was authorized, no live pin moved, and no shared code was edited.

not_installed.scripts/pettripfinder/raleigh_nc_release: replaced by the generic registration_release_lane seal; the frozen helper writes an unresolvable path and is rejected by the isolation proof
not_installed.scripts/pettripfinder/raleigh_nc_authori: replaced by the generic registration_release_lane packet
not_installed.scripts/pettripfinder/raleigh_nc_partici: replaced by the generic registration_release_lane register; the frozen helper imports the assembler and writes an unresolvable scratch path, and is rejected by the isolation proof for exactly those reasons
not_installed.scripts/pettripfinder/raleigh_nc_candida: a proof the FAST lane's rule K already carries; the frozen helper runs the assembler as a subprocess and is rejected for that

per_step.step: A install captured acquisition inputs + helpers
B build policy package + proposed authority
E compare regenerated outputs with the frozen branch

regression_v2.mode: normal -- narrow mode was NOT forced
regression_v2.reason: every changed file classifies into a narrow class (COMPOSITE_FRESH_MARKET_DATA_ONLY, GENERATED_REPORT_ONLY, MARKET_DATA_PACKAGE); no row of the matrix makes a broad regression mandatory

change_set.why: every one of 41 changed paths is in exactly one narrow bucket for raleigh-nc (11 market-local, 15 registration data, 15 derived; 0 shared, 0 unknown), and the only blockers are the two the registration owns

market_local_zone.why: every one of 11 market-local path(s) passed all five isolation conditions in registration mode

discovery_config.why: the discovery config loads for exactly raleigh-nc and the OSM-extract registry gains exactly one row for it with every existing row semantically identical; no discovery code or provider configuration changed

registration_input.why: the registration input is a ptf-market-proposed-authority/1.0 document for exactly raleigh-nc, its counts reconcile, every identity is in the census, and the written shard binds to it

identity_resolutions.why: 1 additive ruling(s) for raleigh-nc validate under the publication guard, name exact committed identities, are DISTINCT pairwise under the exclusion contract, and every pre-existing ruling is byte-identical; no slug or name collides

participation.why: one row added at SOURCE_READY_BUT_NOT_FOUNDER_AUTHORIZED_FOR_LAUNCH by a non-founder writer; every other row, the authorized set and the chain are carried forward exactly

release_contract.why: a new contract instance: shared release rules identical to every base contract, data fields recognized, numbers agree with derive_authority

build_closure.why: the closure gains exactly the market's two declared inputs and one note; code modules, per-market inputs and every build control are unchanged

derived_globals.why: the committed globals are byte-identical to a regeneration from the shards and no other market's shard changed, so their diff is exactly raleigh-nc's contribution

sealed_package.why: package pkg-raleigh-nc-4e278ba02c6cd8a4 is sealed from exactly the head bytes, for REGISTERED_LIVE, declaring one joining market against the current live parent

fast_receipt.why: receipt pkg-raleigh-nc-4e278ba02c6cd8a4-cc53fcba7e187035.json: 15/15 PASS, 0 UNKNOWN, 0 FAILED, bound to the package, the live parent, the intended delta and the current lane and builder versions

expected_release.why: EXPECTED (live parent + sealed package) and ACTUAL (committed authority) agree as complete sets: 14 markets, 965 profiles, 1101 routes; 0 unexpected changes

identity_routes.why: release_index.compare is clean over both the expected and the actual release: no cross-market identity collision, no duplicate route, no ownership movement, every live member preserved, every change declared

market_state_pin.why: the pin gains exactly one block whose eight counts equal what the sealed package derives, agrees with the release contract, and every other block is byte-identical

release_integrity.why: no deployment authorization, record, manifest, activation flag, production gate or deployment pin moved; the live parent is verified and the authorized set is unchanged

authorization_readiness_packet.what_this_is: A prepared, UNSIGNED readiness document for founder review, written by the registration release lane after Regression V2 classified the registration. It authorizes nothing: no launch-participation flag has moved, no activation flag is enabled, nothing is deployed. The founder's decision, if it comes, is a separate write into deploy/netlify/deployment_authorizations/ that this document never makes.

what_is_not_claimed: This document authorizes nothing. Only a founder authorization in deploy/netlify/deployment_authorizations/ admits a market to production.
The whole-site deployment artifact is built and hashed by the deployment order, under the current-parent guard, the exact-bytes rule and the rollback guard, none of which this lane touches.
